newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Pannon-Flax boosts capital by HUF 180mln.
newsitem.headline: Pannon-Flax boosts capital by HUF 180mln.

text.p: Hungarian linen producer Pannon-Flax Gyori Lenszovo Rt said on Monday that Magictrade Kft, one of its largest shareholders, had raised Pannon-Flax's registered capital by 180 million forints to 627.6 million forints.

Magictrade boosted the capital by the maximum amount allowed by the recent meeting of Pannon-Flax shareholders, Pannon-Flax said in a statement in the Budapest Stock Exchange's (BSE) official gazette.

Pannon-Flax said earlier that last year's investments of 91 million forints and this year's planned investment of 118.2 million would bolster sales and pending sources, it will have to invest another nearly 100 million forints for computerised product planning and the securement of its own steam supply.
One possible way of financing was a capital increase, the company said.
Pannon-Flax closed at 1,200 forints on the BSE on June 6, the last day when the share was traded there.
